test_title: SSC CPO 2023 Official Paper-I (Held On: 05 Oct, 2023 Shift 1)
subject: general
question:
The pie chart below shows the spendings of a state on various sports during a particular year:

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/9ebac852784ea901f5c20209048d2348999c803e2f7228f6970d9d43118ab667.png] 

If the total amount spent on sports during the year was Rs. 75,00,000 then how much (in ₹) was spent on cricket and hockey together?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] **__Shortcut Trick__**

 

⇒ 100% = 7500000

1% = 75000

Cricket and Hockey (20%+13%) = 33% = 75000×33 = 2475000

**∴ ₹ 24,75,000 was spent on cricket and hockey together**
